aiVerification.summary: The workbook is a comparable new-machine VP/CD adhesion validation, but the draft has incorrect title/factor evidence and ambiguous outcome grouping that must be corrected before use.
issues: Review title is taken from a Decap NG analysis sheet instead of the primary Test sheet validation title.
Changed-factor evidence does not cite the strongest rows proving the primary comparison, especially Test!2, Test!6, and Test!9.
Changed condition incorrectly mixes the aggregate label 'Total' with the actual test condition; 'Total' should be treated as an aggregate/subresult, not part of the changed factor.
Several measurement outcomes appear to be auto-extracted numeric tables with questionable grouping, including rows where defect-count tables are duplicated as measurements.
Decap NG daily sheets appear to be related follow-up NG analysis but are not clearly integrated as outcomes or explicitly excluded, creating incomplete outcome grouping.
Some evidence rows cited by the draft are not shown in the supplied contextRows, so row existence alone is insufficient to verify semantic accuracy.
correctionPlan: Set the review title to the Test sheet title: report test new machine VP/CD adhesion DT after improve base of machine BRS-161016.
Define the primary changed factor as Normal sample vs Test new machine VP/CD adhesion DT after improved machine base, with 'Total' used only for aggregate result rows.
Add Test!2, Test!6, and Test!9 as changed-factor/purpose evidence rows and remove Decap NG title row from changed-factor evidence unless used only as related NG-analysis context.
Recheck Test!77-Test!106 table structure so vision defects, function defects, and tension test are separated correctly and not duplicated as generic measurement statistics.
Review Test!18, Test!34, Test!61-Test!70 as UV/LED process-condition measurements and retain only if they are relevant to the same validation context with clear row-level grouping.
Decide whether Decap NG 27.6 through 5.7 sheets should be added as related post-test NG-analysis outcomes under the same validation report or excluded from this ReviewCase with a limitation.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Evidence row IDs appear to exist, but citations are not semantically sufficient because key primary-purpose rows are missing and several cited rows need table-structure verification.
